h:
最初创建此工作流程是为了让我可以使用不同的提示和分数标签来测试各种模型。因此，我创建了一种简单的方法来放入一堆提示并更改模型或分数标签或任何你想要的东西。

  • v1.1 支持 loras 并包含 Lora Stacks。

  • 自定义开关可轻松在提示之间切换。

  • 批量图片的图像选择器。默认绕过。

  • “查找和替换”，这样您就可以更改乐谱标签，而不必更改每个提示。

  • Vae 输入开关可在烘焙 VAE 和可选 VAE 之间切换。

  • 目前支持 6 种不同的提示。

  • 请把NK_Switches_Complete_v3.py文件位于您的自定义节点文件夹中。

  • 使用 2x 高档，工作流程运行高档 2 次，因此最终将是 4 倍高档。

o.en:
This workflow was created initially so I could test a wide range of models with different prompts and score tags. So I created an easy way to put in a bunch of prompts and change models or score tags or anything you want.

  • v1.1 has support for loras and includes Lora Stacks.

  • Custom switch to easily switch between prompts.

  • Image Chooser for batch pictures. Bypassed by default.

  • "Find and Replace" so you can change the score tags without having to change every prompt.

  • Vae Input Switch to swap between baked and optional VAE.

  • Supports 6 different prompts right now.

  • Please put the NK_Switches_Complete_v3.pyfile in your custom nodes folder.

  • Use 2x upscale, workflow runs the upscale 2 times so it will be a 4x upscale in the end.
